name: review_file_frame_read
description: Start a job to read one exact frame from a source video or a saved project's program as a bounded review JPEG. Poll file_job_status_read and then call review_file_frame_result_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct job. Reuse for identical retries.

file.description: Absolute path to source video. Reads the source clock.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a saved project.

at.description: Time in seconds, timecode, or exact rational seconds such as 1001/30000.

clock.description: Saved-project clock. Defaults to sequence for a sequence project and assembly for a multicam project. Group reads the group switch lane.

name: review_file_frame_result_read
description: Read the JPEG and frame metadata for a successful review_file_frame_read job. Returns one image/jpeg content block. The image is at most 640 pixels on either axis and 1 MiB before base64 encoding.
